d:
Bihar sarkar ke mantri aur jediyu neta ashok chaudhri ki asistent prophesar ke pad par niyukti ko lekar vivad khara ho gaya hai. ophis oph prophit yani labh ke pad ke is mamle men rajabhvan ne mahadhivakta se kanuni ray mangi hai, vahin aarjedi neta manoj jha ne bhi saval uthae hain. kya ashok chaudhri ki vidhan parishad sadasyata par khatra hai? samjhie pura mamla aur janie kya kahta hai sanvidhan...
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
